message: 洋菓子ＪＩＳ規格
And so, we arrived at 'Chocolat l'Or'

name: Fuyuka
message: 「I see. In that case, we would be delighted to open a stall.」
Chocolat's representative was a woman around my age named Fuyuka-san.

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Not at all. There is no need to bow your head so deeply. Interaction between each Chocolat chain store and the local community is very important, after all.」
Apparently, she wasn't just a branch manager, but a high-ranking figure from the main office who occasionally made the rounds--and a member of the family that runs Chocolat.
Even so, to reach an agreement so easily with the most famous shop, one that's even expanded nationwide... Maybe I'm actually in luck.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Now then, let us move on to the specifics. Roughly how much space are you planning to allocate for our stall?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, yes, right here.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「S-Such a vast area?! Could this perhaps be a reflection of your discernment that our shop possesses that much value?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Of course, our shop has no hesitation in demonstrating the value befitting your estimation.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no. It's just one corner of the buffet section over there.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We'd really love for you to participate in our sweets buffet,\nyou see--」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Buffet?」
Her tone of voice just changed all of a sudden.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Did you just say a buffet?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa, this person is totally ignorant. The meaning of 'buffet' is--」
I clapped my hand over Lolotte's mouth.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Would you care to enlighten me as to what exactly you have in mind by 'buffet'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's a project where we reach out to all the major Western confectioneries in Ryuusei Town and have everyone collaborate on a cake buffet.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「...I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that make sense to you now?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Using Chocolat's cakes for a buffet... You certainly look down on us, don't you.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not what we meant at all--」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Our shop is a long-established institution boasting 102 years of history as a chocolatier.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As a cake shop, though, it's only been around twenty years, right?」
Whoa. Things are taking a bad turn!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course, of course I know how highly regarded Chocolat l'Or's sweets are. Besides, I eat them myself about once a month.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「You've eaten them, you say. And yet you still intend to have us participate in a buffet... It seems you possess quite a cheap palate.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Oh... My palate is cheap, is it?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「The taste of someone who thinks of dragging Chocolat's cakes out into a cheap venue like a buffet is hardly worth mentioning.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It sounds like you're looking down quite a bit on buffets, though...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「I'm not looking down on them at all. I'm simply saying it would be troubling to have our cakes lumped together with the kind lined up at a casual, everyday buffet.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Do you have any idea how particular we are about our ingredients and methods... when you say things like that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In other words, you don't want to participate because it's a buffet?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Yes. To put it plainly, I have no choice but to say so.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「It seems you've finally come to understand.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「What is that 'hah' supposed to mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no, it just slipped out. I see--so here in Ryuusei Town, only Chocolat is special.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「If you were to put it crudely, it could be taken that way.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like hell it is--!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「What did you just say?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, I'll say it as many times as you want. Like hell it is, you arrogant twintails!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「How dare you!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nanaka, calm down!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then what? Are you saying there's as big a gap between Sans Souci's cheesecake and Chocolat's cheesecake as a paper lantern and a temple bell!?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「'Sans Souci'...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You didn't even know that and you were bragging that only your place is authentic? It's a shop that's participating in the buffet!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「A buffet... Hmph, that shop clearly has neither policy nor pride」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh yeah? Well, as far as I'm concerned, they're just different genres, and theirs actually scores higher!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Wha--!? How could someone like you possibly be qualified to judge that!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Everyone agreed to participate because they trust my palate!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「W-What do you mean...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn's the president and I'm just the treasurer, so I don't have the final say, but a shop where someone who looks down on buffets acts all high and mighty...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We don't need you setting up a stall!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「You're the ones who came begging us, and that's how you talk?! Who would ever set up a stall for you!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa. Talks have broken down. This is what they call total fragmentation.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not it at all. Nanaka, you're going too far.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, you're so cool, keep going!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yuugiri-senpai, right there, go for it!」

name: Synn
message: 「You two, don't egg them on while stuffing your faces!」
Whoa. Everyone in the cafe corner is staring straight at us!

name: Nanaka
message: 「First of all, Kirafes doesn't exist just to advertise your shop!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This Kirafes exists for sweets! So everyone can happily enjoy sweets!」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, Kirafes isn't just for sweets--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I said before, there's no high or low in sweets. It's a pure world decided by taste alone!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And I'm not letting someone clinging to petty pride and policy lecture us about it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm getting mad for the sake of all those not-so-famous yet sparklingly delicious sweets across the country!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Listen to youuuu」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, calm down, Fuyuka-san. The customers are watching」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Grr... ahem」
Perhaps noticing the curious stares coming from the cafe area, she clears her throat once.
Forcing a strained smile onto her face.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Having listened to your arguments just now, I couldn't help but feel...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「It sounds to me as though you do not recognize the value of our establishment, or am I imagining things?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's delicious, sure. It's just not head and shoulders above the other cake shops in this town」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nanaka. That's enough already--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're being way too blunt, Treasurer」

name: Synn
message: 「Not that it's any different from how you usually are, though」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Our talented staff uses the finest ingredients and makes daily improvements based on customer surveys」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Chocolat's cakes are head and shoulders above the rest!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Being head and shoulders above the rest is impossible under your current system. Probably」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「How high and mighty for an outsider! How dare you talk like you know everything!」
The atmosphere is getting tenser by the second. What am I supposed to do!
All the customers in the cafe area are staring right at us--or rather, when did the place get completely packed!

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm an outsider, sure. But this is a structural issue common to large-scale chain stores」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Hmph. So that's it」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Certainly, in those kinds of stores, cakes and meals alike are mass-produced in factories and distributed nationwide, so the flavor never rises above a safe, utterly average standard」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「However, lumping us together with convenience store or supermarket chains is the height of ignorance!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「We may purchase our raw ingredients in bulk, yes, but the actual baking is done on-site by each branch's pastry chefs! We maintain meticulous quality control!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I know that much. I'm saying this knowing full well how it works」
Ah, is there really no one left who can stop Nanaka.

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey. You two, stop just eating and--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aah. Picking a fight with Nana-chan this hard is gonna end badly, I think~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Still, Yuugiri-senpai's palate is totally fair! She'd never let personal feelings get in the way!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Still, that manager sure is hanging in there~」

name: Yumil
message: 「She doesn't seem like a bad person, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Talking like this has nothing to do with you...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「In any case, I have no need for concern from a half-baked amateur like you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not really worried or anything, just saying it can't be helped」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Continuing to rant without even admitting your own mistakes--how despicable」
Spitting out those words, Fuyuka-san turned toward me and spoke with a picture-perfect smile.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Chocolat wishes to cherish the people of this community」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「However, I cannot entrust my adorable cakes to an event organized by someone who lacks both manners and a decent sense of taste」
Now that things have soured this much, there's no opening left at all.

name: Synn
message: 「Understood. I apologize for taking up your time」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「You must have a hard time having a companion like this, Mr. President. Though I suppose it can't be helped since she was elected. Now then, if you'll excuse me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I was utterly captivated by how splendidly things fell apart. It was just like a drama」

name: Synn
message: 「...That's not something to admire. Nanaka, we're leaving」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, yeah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry, Synn, I made things go sideways」

name: Synn
message: 「It can't be helped. They're the ones who said they didn't want a buffet」
Nanaka's looking pretty down...
Her phrasing was rough, sure, but I couldn't think that everything Nanaka said was wrong.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, the negotiations didn't work out, but you're still gonna eat some sweets before we go, right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, is that okay? But...」

name: Synn
message: 「For once, it's my treat today」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeh!? 'It's going to rain tomorrow.' So this is the kind of situation you use that phrase in」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, that's impossible. Financially speaking」

name: Synn
message: 「How come Nanaka knows more about what's inside my wallet than I do!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You are quite an airhead, Mr. President. Even I was able to tell」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it was--!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll just accept the thought. Thanks, Synn」
We sat down at the table that Sacchin and the others had claimed.
Maybe because of our argument just now, it felt like the other customers were staring at us, though... I'm just being self-conscious, right.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, you were so cool~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No I wasn't. It was the right call sweets-wise, though... as the treasurer, I feel like there were a lot of issues...」

name: Yumil
message: 「With stuff like that, as the honorary president, it's best to lay it down firm, real firm」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Coming from Yumil, who laid it down too firm, ticked off the upperclassmen, and got booted from the Track Club, that's really convincing」

name: Yumil
message: 「Ahaha. Yeah, that happened too」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's what happened」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You quit the Track Club too, Yumil-san? We are comrades, then」

name: Yumil
message: 「Oh, you did too?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There was no future for our potential in that place」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that supposed to mean」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I went ahead and ordered the new sweets for us~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're only thoughtful about stuff like that, Sacchin」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~」
After a little while, a slice of cake is set down in front of each of us.
It's Chocolat's new chocolate cake, "Tarte Guadalajara."

name: Yumil
message: 「Looks gorgeous」

name: Sacchin
message: 「'Winter der Linden' has something similar, but this one feels way more refined~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, uh... there are scraps of gold paper mixed into this chocolate batter...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whaaat are you talking about, Synn-kun? That's gold leaf~」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaaaaaaat!? Then if I collect this, I'll become filthy rich overnight!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're so funny, Synn-kun」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I hear it's also found in fine wines, so I don't think it's anything to be all that surprised about」

name: Synn
message: 「No, but, this... isn't it expensive? I can't eat something this pricey!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Nobody is asking you to pay for it, so you mustn't worry about the price」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama is way too timid」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, you were here?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, everyone. We probably shouldn't talk too loudly」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why is that?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Look around you」
Before I knew it, the gazes of the customers packed into the cafe space were all focused on us.
No, not on us--on Nanaka alone.
Everyone was stealing glances at Nanaka while pretending not to look our way.
Everyone held their breath, the room dead silent.
Yet Nanaka seemed completely oblivious to her surroundings, carefully wiping her hands with a wet towel.

name: Synn
message: 「What... is going on here?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's always like this when she tries a new menu item. Plus, we're being recorded by a directional mic, so we shouldn't say anything careless」
Looking where Sacchin pointed, I saw a tiny shiny something attached to the paper napkin. No way, a miniature mic!?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Somehow, this is getting exciting」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Right?」
Before I realized it, even Auntie Shinagawa had blended into the crowd of customers! Even Tame-san was there!
What on earth is about to happen!?

name: Fuyuka
message: 「How do you like our shop's newest creation, the Tarte Guadalajara?」
Looking toward the voice, Fuyuka-san had silently appeared beside us and was looking down our way.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「This graceful design! And this delicate yet passionate chocolate flavor, crafted using select, high-grade Guadalajara cacao beans from South America」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「And inside the firmly baked, crispy biscuit crust lies a ganache blended with custard at a patent-pending ratio!」
She must have immense confidence in this new cake.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「It is a brand-new creation born from over half a year of research, prototyping, and tastings. A signature sweet made with wholehearted dedication and spirit by our talented staff」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Savor to your heart's content a luxury that rivals even the most famous patisseries in Europe」
Fuyuka-san is looking at Nanaka triumphantly.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Though I suppose a half-baked palate wouldn't be able to tell the difference」
Nanaka showed no reaction whatsoever to the provocative remark.
She had such a serious expression on her face that I couldn't help being captivated.
Nanaka put her hands together and murmured quietly.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thank you for the food」
Drawn in by her, the rest of us also--

name: Everyone
message: 「Thank you for the food」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Thank you for the food」
The cafe falls dead silent. An eerie atmosphere.
Even the staff are looking over at us with worried glances.
Nanaka savors the Tarte Guadalajara with truly graceful movements.
I forgot all about eating and just stared at Nanaka.
The fingers handling the silver fork looked so slender and dexterous, unimaginable given the strength with which she slaps my back.
Her lips, faintly stained with chocolate, looked soft, and
Her long eyelashes were fine, even, and pretty, and
It was the first time I had ever gazed at Nanaka so intently.
It felt kind of strange.
It was as if I were sitting in front of a girl I was seeing for the very first time.

name: Lolotte
message: 「President」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, what」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you aren't going to eat it, please give it to me」
Lolotte's plate was completely empty.

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're stingy, President」
I wanted to argue back in all sorts of ways, but before that, I dug into my dessert.
Mmm. It's good! So good!
And while I was absorbed in moving my fork, Nanaka's dessert grew smaller and smaller, until
The final morsel vanished between her lips.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew... Thank you for the meal」
Nothing remained on Nanaka's plate.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hey, Nana-chan」
Sacchin, who had finished eating long ago, whispered.

name: Sacchin
message: 「That was delicious~ I wonder how many points it'll get~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...65 points」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」
A murmur of shock erupts from the surrounding customers.

name: Yumil
message: 「Harsh critic as always!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The world of competition is truly unforgiving. Ah, I see, so this is what they mean by a lioness throwing her cubs into a bottomless ravine」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, 'world of competition,' in the first place?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Why is it so low!? Don't talk so big when you're just a half-baked amateur!」
Oh, Fuyuka-san's face is twitching.

name: Sacchin
message: 「65 points means she's totally safe~」

name: Yumil
message: 「If it had dropped below 60, she would've been in trouble, though」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's a relief for Chocolat too~」
At those words, the onlookers nodded in unison.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「W-What is the meaning of this?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not low. I think it's delicious」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Then why is the score so low!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The subtle hint of vanilla beans mixed into the ganache works really well as a secret ingredient」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The pate sucree... the biscuit-like tart crust is also nicely browned, crisp, and top-notch」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As for the design, the framboise offsets the monotony that chocolate sweets tend to fall into, which I think is great」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「...It seems you're not just some half-baked amateur after all」
The look of disdain vanished from Fuyuka-san's face--

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because I pay out of my own pocket to eat them」
Nanaka looked at Fuyuka-san and smiled.
Ooooh!
Somehow, Nanaka looks really cool! I was a little worried she was just a sweets addict, though. Turns out she's not 'just' one!
You'd never guess she's someone who can't cook anything besides soba!

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's not really a compliment, is it」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Did I say that out loud?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Loud and clear~」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Sixty-five points, eh? Harsh as ever.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Well, if it's Nanaka-chan's verdict, it's gotta be fair... Alright, now that it's got her seal of approval, guess I'll try one myself.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Then I believe I'll have one too.」
In the surrounding seats, some people were sending emails somewhere, while others had pulled out laptops and were typing something up.
Could they be sending Nanaka's verdict somewhere...? No way.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Way~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Did I say that out loud again?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yep. You see, for the past two or three years in Ryuusei Town, the scores Nana-chan gives have become the absolute standard for pastry shops~ ...Though she hasn't noticed it herself~」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaaat?!」
Then those emails and the stuff they're typing on their laptops...

name: Sacchin
message: 「Shhh. If she finds out, she might hold back on her scoring, right~? So it's a secret~」

name: Synn
message: 「Then if something scores under sixty...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It means the sweet-tooths of Ryuusei Town won't buy that dessert anymore~」
Nanaka is terrifying!

name: Fuyuka
message: 「What did you mean earlier?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「About the problem common to chain stores?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Yes.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I think it's that they don't deeply understand their raw ingredients.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「...What do you mean by that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For example, take the flour used in this biscuit dough. For a chain the scale of 'Chocolat,' you buy wheat in massive bulk to keep ingredient costs down, right?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Yes... we do. However, we only contract with farms that practice organic cultivation.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The small shops I know... You know the wheat that flour is made from, right?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Y-Yes.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They know the faces of the wheat farmers, what land it comes from, and the subtle seasonal differences in each harvest--and they bake their cakes knowing all of that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「While keeping all that in mind, we also make fine adjustments to how we knead the dough and set the ovens depending on that day's temperature and humidity.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Indeed... That level of meticulous care simply isn't possible at a scale like ours.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「I apologize for writing you off as a half-baked amateur.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't sweat it. I am a half-baked amateur, after all. Forever and always」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because no matter how many years I live, it's impossible to eat every sweet in the world. That's why I'll forever be a half-baked amateur」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Perhaps so... In fact, that's how it ought to be. Though I often forget.」

name: Yumil
message: 「Looks like they've made up, huh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is this what they call 'after the rain, the blood pools'?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Blood pooling up sounds super scary!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Earlier, you stated that a patisserie's worth is decided by how delicious its sweets are, did you not?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Then our Chocolat l'Or shall prove its worth solely through the deliciousness of our sweets as well.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, yes.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「We would like to open a stall under the terms you proposed... Would that be acceptable?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course! We're glad to have you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We really appreciate your cooperation! Thank you so much!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「No, the pleasure is ours. Sweets only truly shine when all sorts of people get to enjoy them, after all.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Thank you very much! We look forward to your next visit!」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... For a moment there I wasn't sure how things would turn out, so I'm glad it worked out...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Makes all our helping out totally worth it!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Man, that stuff was delicious.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mustn't forget the presence of your capable secretary, either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, you guys didn't do anything」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's not true. I went ahead and placed the order」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I was providing moral support.」

name: Yumil
message: 「I'm gettin' kinda hungry, so wanna grab some crepes or somethin'?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Whoa」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It worked out great, didn't it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, stop hitting me every time」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hahaha. There's no such thing as a bad person in the sweets business, right」
Laughing as she said that, Nanaka was the same old Nanaka.
And yet, she looked just a little bit different.
